text: When I speak thus, I am not speaking as the Master would, but as a fool might, in boasting so confidently.

title: II Corinthians 11:18
text: As so many are boasting of earthly things, I, too, will boast.

title: II Corinthians 11:19
text: For all your cleverness, you tolerate fools willingly enough!

title: II Corinthians 11:20
text: You tolerate a man even when he enslaves you, when he plunders you, when he gets you into his power, when he puts on airs of superiority, when he strikes you in the face!

title: II Corinthians 11:21
text: I admit, to my shame, that we have been weak. But whatever the subject on which others are not afraid to boast--though it is foolish to say so--I am not afraid either!

title: II Corinthians 11:22
text: Are they Hebrews? So am I! Are they Israelites? So am I! Are they descendants of Abraham? So am I!

title: II Corinthians 11:23
text: Are they 'Servants of Christ'? Though it is madness to talk like this, I am more so than they! I have had more of toil, more of imprisonment! I have been flogged times without number. I have been often at death's door.

title: II Corinthians 11:24
text: Five times I received at the hands of the Jews forty lashes, all but one.

title: II Corinthians 11:25
text: Three times I was beaten with rods. Once I was stoned. Three times I was shipwrecked. I have spent a whole day and night in the deep.

title: II Corinthians 11:26
text: My journeys have been many. I have been through dangers from rivers, dangers from robbers, dangers from my own people, dangers from the Gentiles, dangers in towns, dangers in the country, dangers on the sea, dangers among false Brothers.

title: II Corinthians 11:27
text: I have been through toil and hardship. I have passed many a sleepless night; I have endured hunger and thirst; I have often been without food; I have known cold and nakedness.

title: II Corinthians 11:28
text: And, not to speak of other things, there is my daily burden of anxiety about all the Churches.

title: II Corinthians 11:29
text: Who is weak without my being weak? Who is led astray without my burning with indignation?

title: II Corinthians 11:30
text: If I must boast, I will boast of things which show my weakness!

title: II Corinthians 11:31
text: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus--he who is for ever blessed--knows that I am speaking the truth.

title: II Corinthians 11:32
text: When I was in Damascus, the Governor under King Aretas had the gates of that city guarded, so as to arrest me,

title: II Corinthians 11:33
text: But I was let down in a basket through a window in the wall, and so escaped his hands.

title: II Corinthians 12:1
text: I must boast! It is unprofitable; but I will pass to visions and revelations given by the Lord.

title: II Corinthians 12:2
text: I know a man in union with Christ, who, fourteen years ago-- whether in the body or out of the body I do not know; God knows-- was caught up (this man of whom I am speaking) to the third Heaven.

title: II Corinthians 12:3
text: And I know that this man--whether in the body or separated from the body I do not know; God knows--

title: II Corinthians 12:4
text: Was caught up into Paradise, and heard unspeakable things of which no human being may tell.

title: II Corinthians 12:5
text: About such a man I will boast, but about myself I will not boast except as regards my weaknesses.

title: II Corinthians 12:6
text: Yet if I choose to boast, I shall not be a fool; for I shall be speaking no more than the truth. But I refrain, lest any one should credit me with more than he can see in me or hear from me, and because of the marvelous character of the revelations.

title: II Corinthians 12:7
text: It was for this reason, and to prevent my thinking too highly of myself, that a thorn was sent to pierce my flesh--an instrument of Satan to discipline me--so that I should not think too highly of myself.

title: II Corinthians 12:8
text: About this I three times entreated the Lord, praying that it might leave me.

title: II Corinthians 12:9
text: But his reply has been--'My help is enough for you; for my strength attains its perfection in the midst of weakness.' Most gladly, then, will I boast all the more of my weaknesses, so that the strength of the Christ may overshadow me.

title: II Corinthians 12:10
text: That is why I delight in weakness, ill-treatment, hardship, persecution, and difficulties, when borne for Christ. For, when I am weak, then it is that I am strong!

title: II Corinthians 12:11
text: I have been "playing the fool!" It is you who drove me to it. For it is you who ought to have been commending me! Although I am nobody, in no respect did I prove inferior to the most eminent Apostles.

title: II Corinthians 12:12
text: The marks of the true Apostle were exhibited among you in constant endurance, as well as by signs, by marvels, and by miracles.

title: II Corinthians 12:13
text: In what respect, I ask, were you treated worse than the other Churches, unless it was that, for my part, I refused to become a burden to you? Forgive me the wrong I thus did you!

title: II Corinthians 12:14
text: Remember, this is the third time that I have made every preparation to come to see you, and I shall refuse to be a burden to you; I want, not your money, but you. It is not the duty of children to put by for their parents, but of parents to put by for their children.

title: II Corinthians 12:15
text: For my part, I will most gladly spend, and be spent, for your welfare. Can it be that the more intensely I love you the less I am to be loved?

title: II Corinthians 12:16
text: You will admit that I was not a burden to you but you say that I was "crafty" and caught you "by a trick"!

title: II Corinthians 12:17
text: Do you assert that I took advantage of you through any of those whom I have sent to you?

title: II Corinthians 12:18
text: I urged Titus to go, and I sent our Brother with him. Did Titus take any advantage of you? Did not we live in the same Spirit, and tread in the same footsteps?

title: II Corinthians 12:19
text: Have you all this time been fancying that it is to you that we are making our defense? No, it is in the sight of God, and in union with Christ, that we are speaking. And all this, dear friends, is to build up your characters;

title: II Corinthians 12:20
text: For I am afraid that perhaps, when I come, I may find that you are not what I want you to be, and, on the other hand, that you may find that I am what you do not want me to be. I am afraid that I may find quarreling, jealousy, ill-feeling, rivalry, slandering, back-biting, self-assertion, and disorder.

title: II Corinthians 12:21
text: I am afraid lest, on my next visit, my God may humble me in regard to you, and that I may have to mourn over many who have long been sinning, and have not repented of the impurity, immorality, and sensuality, in which they have indulged.

title: II Corinthians 13:1
text: For the third time I am coming to see you. 'By the word of two or three witnesses each statement shall be established.'

title: II Corinthians 13:2
text: I have said it, and I say it again before I come, just as if I were with you on my second visit, though for the moment absent, I say to those who have been long sinning, as well as to all others--that if I come again, I shall spare no one.

title: II Corinthians 13:3
text: And that will be the proof, which you are looking for, that the Christ speaks through me. There is no weakness in his dealings with you. No, he shows his power among you.

title: II Corinthians 13:4
text: For though his crucifixion was due to weakness, his life is due to the power of God. And we, also, are weak in his weakness, but with him we shall live for you through the power of God.

title: II Corinthians 13:5
text: Put yourselves to the proof, to see whether you are holding to the Faith. Test yourselves. Surely you recognize this fact about yourselves--that Jesus Christ is in you! Unless indeed you cannot stand the test!

title: II Corinthians 13:6
text: But I hope that you will recognize that we can stand the test.

title: II Corinthians 13:7
text: We pray God that you may do nothing wrong, not that we may be seen to stand the test, but that you may do what is right, even though we may seem not to stand the test.

title: II Corinthians 13:8
text: We have no power at all against the Truth, but we have power in the service of the Truth.

title: II Corinthians 13:9
text: We are glad when we are weak, if you are strong. And what we pray for is that you may become perfect.

title: II Corinthians 13:10
text: This is my reason for writing as I am now doing, while I am away from you, so that, when I am with you, I may not act harshly in the exercise of the authority which the Lord gave me--and gave me for building up and not for pulling down.

title: II Corinthians 13:11
text: And now, brothers, good-bye. Aim at perfection; take courage; agree together; live in peace. And then God, the source of all love and peace, will be with you.

title: II Corinthians 13:12
text: Greet one another with a sacred kiss.

title: II Corinthians 13:13
text: All Christ's people here send you their greetings.

title: II Corinthians 13:14
text: May the blessing of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the communion with the Holy Spirit, be with you all.

title: Galatians 1:1
text: To the churches in Galatia, from Paul, an Apostle whose commission is not from men and is given, not by man, but by Jesus Christ and God the Father who raised him from the dead;

title: Galatians 1:2
text: And from all the Brothers here.

title: Galatians 1:3
text: May God, our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ, bless you and give you peace. For Christ, to rescue us from this present wicked age,

title: Galatians 1:4
text: Gave himself for our sins, in accordance with the will of God and Father,

title: Galatians 1:5
text: To whom be ascribed all glory for ever and ever. Amen.

title: Galatians 1:6
text: I am astonished at your so soon deserting him, who called you through the love of Christ, for a different 'Good News,'

title: Galatians 1:7
text: Which is really no Good News at all. But then, I know that there are people who are harassing you, and who want to pervert the Good News of the Christ.

title: Galatians 1:8
text: Yet even if we--or if an angel from Heaven were to tell you any other 'Good News' than that which we told you, may he be accursed!

title: Galatians 1:9
text: We have said it before, and I repeat it now--If any one tells you a 'Good News' other than that which you received, may he be accursed!

title: Galatians 1:10
text: Is this, I ask, trying to conciliate men, or God? Am I seeking to please men? If I were still trying to please men, I should not be a servant of Christ.

title: Galatians 1:11
text: I would remind you, Brothers, that the Good News which I told is no mere human invention.

title: Galatians 1:12
text: I, at least, did not receive it from man, nor was I taught it, but it came to me through a revelation made by Jesus Christ.

title: Galatians 1:13
text: You heard, no doubt, of my conduct when I was devoted to Judaism--how I persecuted the Church of God to an extent beyond belief, and made havoc of it,

title: Galatians 1:14
text: And how, in my devotion to Judaism, I surpassed many of my contemporaries among my own people in my intense earnestness in upholding the traditions of my ancestors.

title: Galatians 1:15
text: But when God, who had set me apart even before my birth, and who called me by his love,

title: Galatians 1:16
text: Saw fit to reveal his Son in me, so that I might tell the Good News of him among the Gentiles, then at once, instead of consulting any human being,

title: Galatians 1:17
text: Or even going up to Jerusalem to see those who were Apostles before me, I went to Arabia, and came back again to Damascus.

title: Galatians 1:18
text: Three years afterwards I went up to Jerusalem to make the acquaintance of Peter, and I stayed a fortnight with him.

title: Galatians 1:19
text: I did not, however, see any other Apostle, except James, the Master's brother.

title: Galatians 1:20
text: (As to what I am now writing to you, I call God to witness that I am speaking the truth).

title: Galatians 1:21
text: Afterwards I went to the districts of Syria and Cilicia.

title: Galatians 1:22
text: But I was still unknown even by sight to the Christian Churches in Judea;

title: Galatians 1:23
text: All that they had heard was--'The man who once persecuted us is now telling the Good News of the very Faith of which he once made havoc.'

title: Galatians 1:24
text: And they praised God on my account.

title: Galatians 2:1
text: Fourteen years afterwards I went up to Jerusalem again with Barnabas, and I took Titus also with me.

title: Galatians 2:2
text: It was in obedience to a revelation that I went; and I laid before the Apostles the Good News that I am proclaiming among the Gentiles. I did this privately before those who are thought highly of, for fear that I might possibly be taking, or might have already taken, a course which would prove useless.

title: Galatians 2:3
text: Yet even my companion, Titus, though a Greek, was not compelled to be circumcised.

title: Galatians 2:4
text: But, on account of the false Brothers who had stolen in, the men who had crept in to spy upon the liberty which we have through union with Christ Jesus, in order to bring us back to slavery--

title: Galatians 2:5
text: Why, we did not for a moment yield submission to them, that the Truth of the Good News might be yours always!

title: Galatians 2:6
text: Of those who are thought somewhat highly of--what they once were makes no difference to me; God does not recognize human distinctions--those, I say, who are thought highly of added nothing to my Message.

title: Galatians 2:7
text: On the contrary, they saw that I had been entrusted with the Good News for the Gentiles, just as Peter had been for the Jews.

title: Galatians 2:8
text: For he who gave Peter power for his mission to the Jews gave me, also, power to go to the Gentiles.

title: Galatians 2:9
text: Recognizing the charge entrusted to me, James, Peter, and John, who were regarded as pillars of the Church, openly acknowledged Barnabas and me as fellow-workers, agreeing that we should go to the Gentiles, and they to the Jews.

title: Galatians 2:10
text: Only we were to remember the poor--the very thing I was myself anxious to do.

title: Galatians 2:11
text: But, when Peter came to Antioch, I opposed him to his face; for he stood self-condemned.

title: Galatians 2:12
text: Before certain persons came from James, he had been in the habit of eating with the Gentile converts; but, when they came, he began to withdraw and hold aloof, for fear of offending those who still held to circumcision.

title: Galatians 2:13
text: The rest of the Jewish converts were guilty of the same hypocrisy, so that even Barnabas was led away by it.

title: Galatians 2:14
text: But, when I saw that they were not dealing straightforwardly with the Truth of the Good News, I said to Peter, before them all, "If you, who were born a Jew, adopt Gentile customs, instead of Jewish, why are you trying to compel the Gentile converts to adopt Jewish customs?"

title: Galatians 2:15
text: We, though we are Jews by birth and not outcasts of Gentile origin, know that no one is pronounced righteous as the result of obedience to Law, but only through faith in Christ Jesus.

title: Galatians 2:16
text: So we placed our faith in Christ Jesus, in order that we might be pronounced righteous, as the result of faith in Christ, and not of obedience to Law; for such obedience 'will not result in even one soul's being pronounced righteous.'

title: Galatians 2:17
text: If, while seeking to be pronounced righteous through union with Christ, we were ourselves seen to be outcasts, would that make Christ an agent of sin? Heaven forbid!

title: Galatians 2:18
text: For, if I rebuild the very things that I pulled down, I prove myself to have done wrong.

title: Galatians 2:19
text: I, indeed, through Law became dead to Law, in order to live for God.

title: Galatians 2:20
text: I have been crucified with Christ. So it is no longer I that live, but it is Christ who lives in me; and, as for my present earthly life, I am living it by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave himself for me.

title: Galatians 2:21
text: I do not reject the love of God. If righteousness comes through Law, then there was no need for Christ to die!

title: Galatians 3:1
text: Foolish Galatians! Who has been fascinating you--you before whose very eyes Jesus Christ was depicted upon the cross?

title: Galatians 3:2
text: Here is the one thing that I want to find out from you--Did you receive the Spirit as the result of obedience to Law, or of your having listened with faith?

title: Galatians 3:3
text: Can you be so foolish? After beginning with what is spiritual, do you now end with what is external?

title: Galatians 3:4
text: Did you go through so much to no purpose?--if indeed it really was to no purpose!

title: Galatians 3:5
text: He who supplies you abundantly with his Spirit and endows you with such powers--does he do this as the result of obedience to Law? or as the result of your having listened with faith?

title: Galatians 3:6
text: It is just as it was with Abraham--'He had faith in God, and his faith was regarded by God as righteousness.'

title: Galatians 3:7
text: You see, then, that those whose lives are based on faith are the Sons of Abraham.

title: Galatians 3:8
text: And Scripture, foreseeing that God would pronounce the Gentiles righteous as the result of faith, foretold the Good News to Abraham in the words--'Through thee all the Gentiles shall be blessed.'

title: Galatians 3:9
text: And, therefore, those whose lives are based on faith share the blessings bestowed upon the faith of Abraham.

title: Galatians 3:10
text: All who rely upon obedience to Law are under a curse, for Scripture says--'Cursed is every one who does not abide by all that is written in the Book of the Law, and do it.'

title: Galatians 3:11
text: Again, it is evident that no one is pronounced righteous before God through Law, for we read--'Through faith the righteous man shall find Life.'

title: Galatians 3:12
text: But the Law is not based on faith; no, its words are--'Those who practice these precepts will find Life through them.'

title: Galatians 3:13
text: Christ ransomed us from the curse pronounced in the Law, by taking the curse on himself for us, for Scripture says--'Cursed is any one who is hanged on a tree.'

title: Galatians 3:14
text: And this he did that the blessing given to Abraham might be extended to the Gentiles through their union with Jesus Christ; that so, through our faith, we also might receive the promised gift of the Spirit.

title: Galatians 3:15
text: To take an illustration, Brothers, from daily life--No one sets aside even an agreement between two men, when once it has been confirmed, nor does he add conditions to it.

title: Galatians 3:16
text: Now it was to Abraham that the promises were made, 'and to his offspring.' It was not said 'to his offsprings,' as if many persons were meant, but the words were 'to thy offspring,' showing that one person was meant--and that was Christ.

title: Galatians 3:17
text: My point is this--An agreement already confirmed by God cannot be canceled by the Law, which came four hundred and thirty years later, so as to cause the promise to be set aside.

title: Galatians 3:18
text: If our heritage is the result of Law, then it has ceased to be the result of a promise. Yet God conferred it on Abraham by a promise.

title: Galatians 3:19
text: What, then, you ask, was the use of the Law? It was a later addition, to make men conscious of their wrong-doings, and intended to last only til the coming of that 'offspring' to whom the promise had been made; and it was delivered through angels by a mediator.

title: Galatians 3:20
text: Now mediation implies more than one person, but God is one only.

title: Galatians 3:21
text: Does that set the Law in opposition to God's promises? Heaven forbid! For, if a Law had been given capable of bestowing Life, then righteousness would have actually owed its existence to Law.

title: Galatians 3:22
text: But the words of Scripture represent the whole world as being in bondage to sin, so that the promised blessing, dependent, as it is, upon faith in Jesus Christ, may be given to those who have faith in him.

title: Galatians 3:23
text: Before the coming of faith, we were kept under the guard of the Law, in bondage, awaiting the Faith that was destined to be revealed.

title: Galatians 3:24
text: Thus the Law has proved a guide to lead us to Christ, in order that we may be pronounced righteous as the result of faith.

title: Galatians 3:25
text: But now that faith has come we no longer need a guide.

title: Galatians 3:26
text: For you are all Sons of God, through your faith in Christ Jesus.

title: Galatians 3:27
text: For all of you who were baptized into union with Christ clothed yourselves with Christ.

title: Galatians 3:28
text: All distinctions between Jew and Greek, slave and freeman, male and female, have vanished; for in union with Christ Jesus you are all one.

title: Galatians 3:29
text: And, since you belong to Christ, it follows that you are Abraham's offspring and, under the promise, sharers in the inheritance.

title: Galatians 4:1
text: My point is this--As long as the heir is under age, there is no difference between him and a slave, though he is master of the whole estate.

title: Galatians 4:2
text: He is subject to the control of guardians and stewards, during the period for which his father has power to appoint them.

title: Galatians 4:3
text: And so is it with us; when we were under age, as it were, we were slaves to the puerile teaching of this world;

title: Galatians 4:4
text: But, when the full time came, God sent his Son--born a woman's child, born subject to Law--

title: Galatians 4:5
text: To ransom those who were subject to Law, so that we might take our position as sons.

title: Galatians 4:6
text: And it is because you are sons that God sent into our hearts the Spirit of his Son, with the cry--'Abba, our Father.'

title: Galatians 4:7
text: You, therefore, are no longer a slave, but a son; and, if a son, then an heir also, by God's appointment.

title: Galatians 4:8
text: Yet formerly, in your ignorance of God, you became slaves to 'gods' which were no gods.

title: Galatians 4:9
text: But now that you have found God--or, rather, have been found by him--how is it that you are turning back to that poor and feeble puerile teaching, to which yet once again you are wanting to become slaves?

title: Galatians 4:10
text: You are scrupulous in keeping Days and Months and Seasons and Years!

title: Galatians 4:11
text: You make me fear that the labor which I have spent on you may have been wasted.

title: Galatians 4:12
text: I entreat you, Brothers, to become like me, as I became like you. You have never done me any wrong.

title: Galatians 4:13
text: You remember that it was owing to bodily infirmity that on the first occasion I told you the Good News.

title: Galatians 4:14
text: And as for what must have tried you in my condition, it did not inspire you with scorn or disgust, but you welcomed me as if I had been an angel of God--or Christ Jesus himself!

title: Galatians 4:15
text: What has become then, of your blessings? For I can bear witness that, had it been possible, you would have torn out your eyes and given them to me!

title: Galatians 4:16
text: Am I to think, then, that I have become your enemy by telling you the truth?

title: Galatians 4:17
text: Certain people are seeking your favor, but with no honorable object. No, indeed, they want to isolate you, so that you will have to seek their favor.

title: Galatians 4:18
text: It is always honorable to have your favor sought in an honorable cause, and not only when I am with you, my dear children--

title: Galatians 4:19
text: You for whom I am again enduring a mother's pains, till a likeness to Christ shall have been formed in you.

title: Galatians 4:20
text: But I could wish to be with you now and speak in a different tone, for I am perplexed about you.

title: Galatians 4:21
text: Tell me, you who want to be still subject to Law--Why do not you listen to the Law?

title: Galatians 4:22
text: Scripture says that Abraham had two sons, one the child of the slave-woman and the other the child of the free woman.

title: Galatians 4:23
text: But the child of the slave-woman was born in the course of nature, while the child of the free woman was born in fulfilment of a promise.

title: Galatians 4:24
text: This story may be taken as an allegory. The women stand for two Covenants. One Covenant, given from Mount Sinai, produces a race of slaves and is represented by Hagar

title: Galatians 4:25
text: (The word Hagar meaning in Arabia Mount Sinai) and it ranks with the Jerusalem of to-day, for she and her children are in slavery.

title: Galatians 4:26
text: But the Jerusalem above is free, and she it is who is our mother.

title: Galatians 4:27
text: For Scripture says--'Rejoice, thou barren one, who dost never bear, Break into shouts, thou who art never in labor, For many are the children of her who is desolate--aye, more than of her who has a husband.'

title: Galatians 4:28
text: As for ourselves, brothers, we, like Isaac, are children born in fulfilment of a promise.

title: Galatians 4:29
text: Yet at that time the child born in the course of nature persecuted the child born by the power of the Spirit; and it is the same now.

title: Galatians 4:30
text: But what does the passage of Scripture say? 'Send away the slave-woman and her son; for the slave's son shall not be co-heir with the son of the free woman.'

title: Galatians 4:31
text: And so, Brothers, we are not children of a slave, but of her who is free.

title: Galatians 5:1
text: It is for freedom that Christ set us free; stand firm therefore, and do not again be held under the yoke of slavery.

title: Galatians 5:2
text: Understand that I, Paul, myself tell you that if you allow yourselves to be circumcised, Christ will avail you nothing.

title: Galatians 5:3
text: I again declare to every one who receives circumcision, that he binds himself to obey the whole Law.

title: Galatians 5:4
text: You have severed yourselves from Christ--you who are seeking to be pronounced righteous through Law; you have fallen away from love.

title: Galatians 5:5
text: For we, by the help of the Spirit, are eagerly waiting for the fulfilment of our hope--that we may be pronounced righteous as the result of faith.

title: Galatians 5:6
text: If a man is in union with Christ Jesus, neither is circumcision nor the omission of it anything, but faith, working through love, is everything.

title: Galatians 5:7
text: You were once making good progress! Who has hindered you from obeying the Truth?

title: Galatians 5:8
text: The persuasion brought to bear on you does not come from him who calls you.

title: Galatians 5:9
text: A little leaven leavens all the dough.

title: Galatians 5:10
text: I, through my union with the Lord, am persuaded that you will learn to think with me. But the man who is disturbing your minds will have to bear his punishment, whoever he may be.

title: Galatians 5:11
text: If I, Brothers, am still proclaiming circumcision, why am I still persecuted? It seems that the Cross has ceased to be an obstacle!

title: Galatians 5:12
text: I could even wish that the people who are unsettling you would go further still and mutilate themselves.

title: Galatians 5:13
text: Remember, Brothers, to you the Call came to give you freedom. Only do not make your freedom an opportunity for self-indulgence, but serve one another in a loving spirit.

title: Galatians 5:14
text: Indeed, the whole Law has been summed up in this one precept- -'Thou shalt love thy neighbor as thou dost thyself.'

title: Galatians 5:15
text: But, if you are continually wounding and preying upon one another, take care that you are not destroyed by one another.

title: Galatians 5:16
text: This is what I have to say--Let your steps be guided by the Spirit, and then you will never gratify the cravings of your earthly nature.

title: Galatians 5:17
text: For these cravings of our earthly nature conflict with the Spirit, and the Spirit with our earthly nature--they are two contrary principles--so that you cannot do what you wish.

title: Galatians 5:18
text: But, if you follow the guidance of the Spirit, you are not subject to Law.

title: Galatians 5:19
text: The sins of our earthly nature are unmistakable. They are sins like these--unchastity, impurity, indecency,

title: Galatians 5:20
text: Idolatry, sorcery, quarrels, strife, jealousy, outbursts of passion, rivalries, dissensions, divisions,

title: Galatians 5:21
text: Feelings of envy, drunkenness, revelry, and the like. And I warn you, as I warned you before, that those who indulge in such things will have no place in the Kingdom of God.

title: Galatians 5:22
text: But the fruit produced by the Spirit is love, joy, peace, forbearance, kindliness, generosity, trustfulness, gentleness, self-control.

title: Galatians 5:23
text: Against such things there is no law!

title: Galatians 5:24
text: And those who belong to Jesus, the Christ, have already crucified their earthly nature, with its passions and its cravings.

title: Galatians 5:25
text: Since our Life is due to the Spirit, let us rule our conduct also by the Spirit.

title: Galatians 5:26
text: Do not let us grow vain, and provoke or envy one another.

title: Galatians 6:1
text: Brothers, even if a man should be caught committing a sin, you who are spiritually minded should, in a gentle spirit, help him to recover himself, taking care lest any one of you also should be tempted.

title: Galatians 6:2
text: Bear one another's burdens, and so carry out the Law of the Christ.

title: Galatians 6:3
text: If a man imagines himself to be somebody, when he is really nobody, he deceives himself.

title: Galatians 6:4
text: Let every one test his own work, and then his cause for satisfaction will be in himself and not in a comparison of himself with his neighbor;

title: Galatians 6:5
text: For every one must bear his own load.

title: Galatians 6:6
text: He, however, who is being instructed in the Message ought always to share his blessings with the man who instructs him.

title: Galatians 6:7
text: Do not be deceived. God cannot be mocked. What a man sows that he will reap.

title: Galatians 6:8
text: For he who sows the field of his earthly nature will from that earthly nature reap corruption; while he who sows the field of the spirit will from that spirit reap Immortal Life.

title: Galatians 6:9
text: Let us never tire of doing right, for at the proper season we shall reap our harvest, if we do not grow weary.

title: Galatians 6:10
text: Therefore, I say, as the opportunity occurs, let us treat every one with kindness, and especially members of the Household of the Faith.

title: Galatians 6:11
text: See in what large letters I am writing with my own hand.

title: Galatians 6:12
text: Those who wish to appear to advantage in regard to outward observances are the very people who are trying to compel you to be circumcised; and they do it only to avoid being persecuted for the cross of Jesus, the Christ.

title: Galatians 6:13
text: Even these men who are circumcised do not themselves keep the Law; yet they want you to be circumcised, so that they may boast of your observance of the rite.

title: Galatians 6:14
text: But, for my part, may I never boast of anything except the cross of Jesus Christ, our Master, through whom the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.

title: Galatians 6:15
text: For neither is circumcision nor the omission of it anything; but a new nature is everything.

title: Galatians 6:16
text: May all who rule their conduct by this principle find peace and mercy--they who are the Israel of God.

title: Galatians 6:17
text: For the future let no one trouble me; for I bear the marks of Jesus branded on my body.

title: Galatians 6:18
text: May the blessing of Jesus Christ, our Lord, rest on your souls, Brothers. Amen.

title: Ephesians 1:1
text: To Christ's People [AT EPHESUS] who are faithful to him, from Paul, an Apostle of Christ Jesus, by the will of God.

title: Ephesians 1:2
text: May God, our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ bless you and give you peace.

title: Ephesians 1:3
text: Blessed is the God and Father of Jesus Christ, our Lord, who has blessed us on high with every spiritual blessing, in Christ.

title: Ephesians 1:4
text: For he chose us in our union with Christ before the creation of the universe, that we might be holy and blameless in his sight, living in the spirit of love.

title: Ephesians 1:5
text: From the first he destined us, in his good-will towards us, to be adopted as Sons through Jesus Christ,

title: Ephesians 1:6
text: And so to enhance that glorious manifestation of his loving- kindness which he gave us in The Beloved;

title: Ephesians 1:7
text: For in him, and through the shedding of his blood, we have found redemption in the pardon of our offenses.

title: Ephesians 1:8
text: All this accords with the loving-kindness which God lavished upon us, accompanied by countless gifts of wisdom and discernment,

title: Ephesians 1:9
text: When he made known to us his hidden purpose. And it also accords with the good-will which God purposed to exhibit in Christ,

title: Ephesians 1:10
text: In view of that Divine Order which was to mark the completion of the ages, when he should make everything, both in Heaven and on earth, center in him.

title: Ephesians 1:11
text: In him, I say, for by our union with him we became God's Heritage, having from the first been destined for this in the intention of him who, in all that happens, is carrying out his own fixed purpose;

title: Ephesians 1:12
text: That we should enhance his glory--we who have been the first to rest our hopes on the Christ.

title: Ephesians 1:13
text: And you, too, by your union with him, after you had heard the Message of the Truth, the Good News of your Salvation--you believed in him and were sealed as his by receiving the holy Spirit, which he had promised.

title: Ephesians 1:14
text: And the Spirit is a pledge of our future heritage, fore- shadowing the full redemption of God's own People--to enhance his Glory.

title: Ephesians 1:15
text: And therefore I, ever since I heard of the faith in the Lord Jesus which prevails among you, and of your confidence in all Christ's People,

title: Ephesians 1:16
text: Have never omitted to thank God on your behalf, whenever I make mention of you in my prayers.

title: Ephesians 1:17
text: My prayer is that the God of Jesus Christ our Lord, the all- glorious Father, may inspire you with wisdom and true insight through a fuller knowledge of himself;

title: Ephesians 1:18
text: That your minds may be so enlightened that you may realize the hope given by God's Call, the wealth of the glory of his heritage among Christ's People,

title: Ephesians 1:19
text: And the transcendent greatness of the power which he is able to exercise in dealing with us who believe in him.

title: Ephesians 1:20
text: The same mighty power was exerted upon the Christ, when he raised the Christ from the dead and 'caused him to sit at his right hand' on high, exalting him above all Angels and Archangels of every rank,

title: Ephesians 1:21
text: And above every name that can be named, whether in the present age, or in the age to come.

title: Ephesians 1:22
text: And God placed 'all things under Christ's feet,' and gave him to the Church as its supreme Head;

title: Ephesians 1:23
text: For the Church is Christ's Body, and is filled by him who fills all things everywhere with his presence.

title: Ephesians 2:1
text: You yourselves were once dead because of your offenses and sins.

title: Ephesians 2:2
text: For at one time you lived in sin, following the ways of the world, in subjection to the Ruler of the Powers of the air--the Spirit who is still at work among the disobedient.

title: Ephesians 2:3
text: And it was among them that we all once lived our lives, indulging the cravings of our earthly nature, and carrying out the desires prompted by that earthly nature and by our own thoughts. Our very nature exposed us to the Divine Wrath, like the rest of mankind.

title: Ephesians 2:4
text: Yet God, in his abundant compassion, and because of the great love with which he loved us,

title: Ephesians 2:5
text: Even though we were 'dead' because of our offenses, gave Life to us in giving Life to the Christ. (By God's loving-kindness you have been saved.)

title: Ephesians 2:6
text: And, through our union with Christ Jesus, God raised us with him, and caused us to sit with him on high,

title: Ephesians 2:7
text: In order that, by his goodness to us in Christ Jesus, he might display in the ages to come the boundless wealth of his loving- kindness.

title: Ephesians 2:8
text: For it is by God's loving-kindness that you have been saved, through your faith. It is not due to yourselves; the gift is God's.

title: Ephesians 2:9
text: It is not due to obedience to Law, lest any one should boast.

title: Ephesians 2:10
text: For we are God's handiwork, created, by our union with Christ Jesus, for the good actions in doing which God had pre-arranged that we should spend our lives.

title: Ephesians 2:11
text: Remember, therefore, that you were once Gentiles yourselves, as your bodies showed; you were called 'The Uncircumcised' by those who were called 'The Circumcised'--circumcised only by the hand of man!

title: Ephesians 2:12
text: Remember that you were at that time far from Christ; you were shut out from the citizenship of Israel; you were strangers to the Covenants founded on God's Promise; you were in the world without hope and without God.

title: Ephesians 2:13
text: But now, through your union with Christ Jesus, you who once were 'far off' have, by the shedding of the blood of the Christ, been brought 'near.'

title: Ephesians 2:14
text: He it is who is our Peace. He made the two divisions of mankind one, broke down the barrier that separated them,

title: Ephesians 2:15
text: And in his human nature put an end to the cause of enmity between them--the Law with its injunctions and ordinances--in order to create, through union with himself, from Jew and Gentile, one New Man and thus make peace.

title: Ephesians 2:16
text: And when, upon the cross, he had destroyed their mutual enmity, he sought by means of his cross to reconcile them both to God, united in one Body.

title: Ephesians 2:17
text: He came with the Good News of peace for you who were 'far off,' and of peace for those who were 'near';

title: Ephesians 2:18
text: For it is through him that we, the Jews and the Gentiles, united in the one Spirit, are now able to approach the Father.

title: Ephesians 2:19
text: It follows, then, that you are no longer strangers and aliens, but are fellow-citizens with Christ's People and members of God's Household.

title: Ephesians 2:20
text: You have been built up upon the foundation laid by the Apostles and Prophets, Christ Jesus himself being 'the corner- stone.'

title: Ephesians 2:21
text: United in him, every part of the building, closely joined together, will grow into a Temple, consecrated by its union with the Lord.

title: Ephesians 2:22
text: And, through union in him, you also are being built up together, to be a dwelling-place for God through the Spirit.

title: Ephesians 3:1
text: For this reason I, Paul, the prisoner of Jesus, the Christ, for the sake of you Gentiles--

title: Ephesians 3:2
text: For you have heard, I suppose, of the responsible charge with which God entrusted me for your benefit,

title: Ephesians 3:3
text: And also that it was by direct revelation that the hidden purpose of God was made known to me, as I have already briefly told you.

title: Ephesians 3:4
text: And, by reading what I have written, you will be able to judge how far I understand this hidden purpose of God in Christ.

title: Ephesians 3:5
text: In former generations it was not made known to mankind, as fully as it has now been revealed by the Spirit to the Apostles and Prophets among Christ's People--

title: Ephesians 3:6
text: That, by union with Christ Jesus and through the Good News, the Gentiles are co-heirs with us and members of one Body, and that they share with us in God's Promise.

title: Ephesians 3:7
text: Of this Good News I became a minister, in virtue of the charge with which God entrusted me in the exercise of his power--

title: Ephesians 3:8
text: Yes, to me, who am less than the least of all Christ's People, was this charge entrusted!--to tell the Gentiles the Good News of the boundless wealth to be found in the Christ,

title: Ephesians 3:9
text: And to make clear what is God's way of working out that hidden purpose which from the first has been concealed in the mind of the Creator of all things;

title: Ephesians 3:10
text: So that now to the Archangels and to all the Powers on high should be made known, through the Church, the all-embracing wisdom of God,

title: Ephesians 3:11
text: In accordance with that purpose which runs through all the ages and which he has now accomplished in Jesus, the Christ, our Master.

title: Ephesians 3:12
text: And in union with him, and through our trust in him, we find courage to approach God with confidence.

title: Ephesians 3:13
text: Therefore I beg you not to be disheartened at the sufferings that I am undergoing for your sakes; for they redound to your honor.

title: Ephesians 3:14
text: For this reason, then, I kneel before the Father--

title: Ephesians 3:15
text: From whom all 'fatherhood' in Heaven and on earth derives its name--

title: Ephesians 3:16
text: And pray that, in proportion to the wealth of his glory, he will strengthen you with his power by breathing his Spirit into your inmost soul,

title: Ephesians 3:17
text: So that the Christ, through your faith, may make his home within your hearts in love; And I pray that you, now firmly rooted and established, may, with all Christ's People,

title: Ephesians 3:18
text: Have the power to comprehend in all its width and length and height and depth,

title: Ephesians 3:19
text: And to understand--though it surpasses all understanding--the love of the Christ; and so be filled to the full with God himself.

title: Ephesians 3:20
text: To him who, through his power which is at work within us, is able to do far more than anything that we can ask or conceive--

title: Ephesians 3:21
text: To him be all glory through the Church and through Christ Jesus, for all generations, age after age. Amen.

title: Ephesians 4:1
text: I urge you, then--I who am a prisoner in the Master's cause-- to live lives worthy of the Call that you have received;

title: Ephesians 4:2
text: Always humble and gentle, patient, bearing lovingly with one another,

title: Ephesians 4:3
text: And striving to maintain in the bond of peace the unity given by the Spirit.

title: Ephesians 4:4
text: There is but one Body and one Spirit, just as there was but one hope set before you when you received your Call.

title: Ephesians 4:5
text: There is but one Lord, one Faith, one Baptism.

title: Ephesians 4:6
text: There is but one God and Father of all--the God who is over all, pervades all, and is in all.

title: Ephesians 4:7
text: Every one of us, however, has been entrusted with some charge, each in accordance with the extent of the gift of the Christ.

title: Ephesians 4:8
text: That is why it is said--'When he went up on high, he led his captives into captivity. And gave gifts to mankind.'

title: Ephesians 4:9
text: Now surely this 'going up' must imply that he had already gone down into the world beneath.

title: Ephesians 4:10
text: He who went down is the same as he who went up--up beyond the highest Heaven, that he might fill all things with his presence.

title: Ephesians 4:11
text: And he it is who gave to the Church Apostles, Prophets, Missionaries, Pastors, and Teachers,

title: Ephesians 4:12
text: To fit his People for the work of the ministry, for the building up of the Body of the Christ.

title: Ephesians 4:13
text: And this shall continue, until we all attain to that unity which is given by faith and by a fuller knowledge of the Son of God; until we reach the ideal man--the full standard of the perfection of the Christ.

title: Ephesians 4:14
text: Then we shall no longer be like infants, tossed backward and forward, blown about by every breath of human teaching, through the trickery and the craftiness of men, towards the snares of error;

title: Ephesians 4:15
text: But holding the truth in a spirit of love, we shall grow into complete union with him who is our Head--Christ himself.

title: Ephesians 4:16
text: For from him the whole Body, closely joined and knit together by the contact of every part with the source of its life, derives its power to grow, in proportion to the vigor of each individual part; and so is being built up in a spirit of love.

title: Ephesians 4:17
text: This, then, as one in union with the Lord, I say to you and urge upon you: Do not continue to live such purposeless lives as the Gentiles live,

title: Ephesians 4:18
text: With their powers of discernment darkened, cut off from the Life of God, owing to the ignorance that prevails among them and to the hardness of their hearts.

title: Ephesians 4:19
text: Lost to all sense of shame, they have abandoned themselves to licentiousness, in order to practice every kind of impurity without restraint.

title: Ephesians 4:20
text: But far different is the lesson you learned from the Christ-- if, that is, you really listened to him,

title: Ephesians 4:21
text: And through union with him were taught the Truth, as it is to be found in Jesus.

title: Ephesians 4:22
text: For you learned with regard to your former way of living that you must cast off your old nature, which, yielding to deluding passions, grows corrupt;

title: Ephesians 4:23
text: That the very spirit of your minds must be constantly renewed;

title: Ephesians 4:24
text: And that you must clothe yourselves in that new nature which was created to resemble God, with the righteousness and holiness springing from the Truth.

title: Ephesians 4:25
text: Since, therefore, you have cast off what is false, 'you must every one of you speak the truth to your neighbors.' For we are united to one another like the parts of a body.

title: Ephesians 4:26
text: 'Be angry, yet do not sin.' Do not let the sun go down upon your anger;

title: Ephesians 4:27
text: And give no opportunity to the Devil.

title: Ephesians 4:28
text: Let the man who steals steal no longer, but rather let him toil with his hands at honest work, so that he may have something to share with any one in want.

title: Ephesians 4:29
text: Never let any foul word pass your lips, but only such good words as the occasion demands, that they may be a help to those who hear them.

title: Ephesians 4:30
text: And do not grieve God's Holy Spirit; for it was through that Spirit that God sealed you as his, against the Day of Redemption.

title: Ephesians 4:31
text: Let all bitterness, passion, anger, brawling, and abusive language be banished from among you, as well as all malice.

title: Ephesians 4:32
text: Be kind to one another, tenderhearted, ready to forgive one another, just as God, in Christ, forgave you.

title: Ephesians 5:1
text: Therefore imitate God, as his dear children,

title: Ephesians 5:2
text: And live a life of love, following the example of the Christ, who loved you and gave himself for you as 'an offering and a sacrifice to God, that should be fragrant and acceptable.'

title: Ephesians 5:3
text: As for unchastity and every kind of impurity, or greed, do not let them even be mentioned among you, as befits Christ's People,

title: Ephesians 5:4
text: Nor shameful conduct, nor foolish talk or jesting, for they are wholly out of place among you; but rather thanksgiving.

title: Ephesians 5:5
text: For of this you may be sure--that no one who is unchaste or impure or greedy of gain (for to be greedy of gain is idolatry) has any place awaiting him in the kingdom of the Christ and God.

title: Ephesians 5:6
text: Do not let any one deceive you with specious arguments. Those are the sins that bring down the Wrath of God upon the disobedient.

title: Ephesians 5:7
text: Therefore have nothing to do with such people.

title: Ephesians 5:8
text: For, although you were once in Darkness, now, by your union with the Lord, you are in the Light. Live as 'Children of Light'- -

title: Ephesians 5:9
text: For the outcome of life in the Light may be seen in every form of goodness, righteousness, and sincerity--

title: Ephesians 5:10
text: Always trying to find out what is pleasing to the Lord.

title: Ephesians 5:11
text: Take no part in deeds of Darkness, from which no good can come; on the contrary, expose them.

title: Ephesians 5:12
text: It is degrading even to speak of the things continually done by them in secret.

title: Ephesians 5:13
text: All such actions, when exposed, have their true character made manifest by the Light.

title: Ephesians 5:14
text: For everything that has its true character made manifest is clear as light. And that is why it is said--'Sleeper, awake! Arise from the dead, and the Christ shall give thee light!'

title: Ephesians 5:15
text: Take great care, then, how you live--not unwisely but wisely,

title: Ephesians 5:16
text: Making the most of every opportunity; for these are evil days.

title: Ephesians 5:17
text: Therefore do not grow thoughtless, but try to understand what the Lord's will is.

title: Ephesians 5:18
text: Do not drink wine to excess, for that leads to profligacy; but seek to be filled with the Spirit of God, and speak to one another in psalms and hymns and sacred songs.

title: Ephesians 5:19
text: Sing and make music in your hearts to the Lord.

title: Ephesians 5:20
text: Always give thanks for everything to our God and Father, in the Name of our Lord Jesus Christ;

title: Ephesians 5:21
text: And submit to one another from reverence for him.

title: Ephesians 5:22
text: Wives should submit to their husbands as submitting to the Lord.

title: Ephesians 5:23
text: For a man is the Head of his wife, as the Christ is the Head of the Church--being indeed himself the Savior of his Body.

title: Ephesians 5:24
text: But as the Church submits to the Christ, so also should wives submit to their husbands in everything.

title: Ephesians 5:25
text: Husbands, love your wives, just as the Christ loved the Church, and gave himself for her,

title: Ephesians 5:26
text: To make her holy, after purifying her by the Washing with the Water, according to his promise;

title: Ephesians 5:27
text: So that he might himself bring the Church, in all her beauty, into his own presence, with no spot or wrinkle or blemish of any kind, but that she might be holy and faultless.

title: Ephesians 5:28
text: That is how husbands ought to love their wives--as if they were their own bodies. A man who loves his wife is really loving himself;

title: Ephesians 5:29
text: For no one ever yet hated his own body. But every one feeds his body and cares for it, just as the Christ for the Church;

title: Ephesians 5:30
text: For we are members of his Body.

title: Ephesians 5:31
text: 'For this cause a man shall leave his father and mother, and be united to his wife; and the man and his wife shall become one.'

title: Ephesians 5:32
text: In this there is a profound truth--I am speaking of Christ and his Church.

title: Ephesians 5:33
text: However, for you individually, let each love his wife as if she were himself; and the wife be careful to respect her husband.

title: Ephesians 6:1
text: Children, obey your parents, as children of the Lord; for that is but right.

title: Ephesians 6:2
text: 'Honor thy father and mother'--this is the first Commandment with a promise--'

title: Ephesians 6:3
text: So that thou mayest prosper and have a long life on earth.'

title: Ephesians 6:4
text: And fathers, do not irritate your children, but bring them up with Christian discipline and instruction.

title: Ephesians 6:5
text: Slaves, obey your earthly masters, with anxious care, giving them ungrudging service, as if obeying the Christ;

title: Ephesians 6:6
text: Not only when their eyes are on you, as if you had merely to please men, but as slaves of Christ, who are trying to carry out the will of God.

title: Ephesians 6:7
text: Give your service heartily and cheerfully, as working for the Master and not for men;

title: Ephesians 6:8
text: For you know that every one will be rewarded by the Master for any honest work that he has done, whether he is a slave or a freeman.

title: Ephesians 6:9
text: And masters, treat your slaves in the same spirit. Give up threatening them; for you know that he who is both their Master and yours is in Heaven, and that before him there is no distinction of rank.

title: Ephesians 6:10
text: For the future, find strength in your union with the Lord, and in the power which comes from his might.

title: Ephesians 6:11
text: Put on the full armor of God, so that you may be able to stand your ground against the stratagems of the Devil.

title: Ephesians 6:12
text: For ours is no struggle against enemies of flesh and blood, but against all the various Powers of Evil that hold sway in the Darkness around us, against the Spirits of Wickedness on high.

title: Ephesians 6:13
text: Therefore take up the full armor of God, that, when the evil day comes, you may be able to withstand the attack, and, having fought to the end, still to stand your ground.

title: Ephesians 6:14
text: Stand your ground, then, 'with truth for your belt,' and 'with righteousness for your breast-plate,'

title: Ephesians 6:15
text: And with the readiness to serve the Good News of Peace as shoes for your feet.

title: Ephesians 6:16
text: At every onslaught take up faith for your shield; for with it you will be able to extinguish all the flaming darts of the Evil One.

title: Ephesians 6:17
text: And receive 'the helmet of Salvation,' and 'the sword of the Spirit'--which is the Message of God--always with prayer and supplication.

title: Ephesians 6:18
text: Pray in spirit at all times. Be intent upon this, with unwearying perseverance and supplication for all Christ's People- -

title: Ephesians 6:19
text: And on my behalf also, that, when I begin to speak, words may be given me, so that I may fearlessly make known the inmost truth of the Good News,

title: Ephesians 6:20
text: On behalf of which I am an Ambassador--in chains! Pray that, in telling it, I may speak fearlessly as I ought.

title: Ephesians 6:21
text: To enable you, as well as others, to know all that concerns me and what I am doing, Tychicus, our dear Brother and faithful helper in the Master's Cause, will tell you everything.

title: Ephesians 6:22
text: I am sending him to you on purpose that you may learn all about us, and that he may cheer your hearts.

title: Ephesians 6:23
text: May God, the Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ give our Brothers peace, and love linked with faith.

title: Ephesians 6:24
text: May God's blessing be with all who love our Lord Jesus Christ with an undying love.

title: Philippians 1:1
text: To all Christ's People at Philippi, with the Presiding Officers and Assistants, from Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus.

title: Philippians 1:2
text: May God, our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ bless you, and give you peace.

title: Philippians 1:3
text: Every recollection that I have of you is a cause of thankfulness to God,

title: Philippians 1:4
text: Always, in every prayer that I offer for you all--my prayers are full of joy--

title: Philippians 1:5
text: Because of the share that you have had in spreading the Good News, from the first day that you received it until now.

title: Philippians 1:6
text: For of this I am confident, that he who began a good work in you will complete it in readiness for the Day of Jesus Christ.

title: Philippians 1:7
text: And, indeed, I am justified in feeling thus about you all; because you have a warm place in my heart--you who all, both in my imprisonment and in the work of defending and establishing the Good News, shared my privilege with me.

title: Philippians 1:8
text: God will bear me witness how I yearn over you all with the tenderness of Christ Jesus.

title: Philippians 1:9
text: And what I pray for is this--that your love may grow yet stronger and stronger, with increasing knowledge and all discernment,

title: Philippians 1:10
text: Until you are able to appreciate all moral distinctions. And I pray, too, that you may be kept pure and blameless against the Day of Christ,

title: Philippians 1:11
text: Bearing a rich harvest of that righteousness which comes through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.

title: Philippians 1:12
text: Brothers, I want you to realize that what has happened to me has actually served to forward the Good News.

title: Philippians 1:13
text: It has even become evident, not only to all the Imperial Guard, but to every one else, that it is for Christ's sake that I am in chains.

title: Philippians 1:14
text: And besides this, most of our Brothers have gained confidence in the Lord through my chains, and now venture with far greater freedom to speak of God's Message fearlessly.

title: Philippians 1:15
text: It is true that some do proclaim the Christ out of Jealousy and opposition; but there are others who proclaim him from good- will.

title: Philippians 1:16
text: The latter do it from love for me, knowing that I have been appointed to plead the cause of the Good News.

title: Philippians 1:17
text: The former spread the news of the Christ in a factious spirit, and not sincerely, thinking to add to the pain of my chains.

title: Philippians 1:18
text: But what of that? Only that in some way or other, either with assumed or with real earnestness, Christ is being made known; and at that I rejoice.

title: Philippians 1:19
text: Yes, and I will rejoice, for I know that, through your prayers and through a rich supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ, 'all this will make for my Salvation.'

title: Philippians 1:20
text: And this will fulfil my earnest expectation and hope that I shall have no cause for shame, but that, with unfailing courage, now as hitherto, Christ will be honored in my body, whether by my life or by my death,

title: Philippians 1:21
text: For to me life is Christ, and death is gain.

title: Philippians 1:22
text: But what if the life here in the body--if this brings me fruit from my labors? Then which to choose I cannot tell! I am sorely perplexed either way!

title: Philippians 1:23
text: My own desire is to depart and be with Christ, for this would be far better.

title: Philippians 1:24
text: But, for your sakes, it may be more needful that I should still remain here in the body.

title: Philippians 1:25
text: Yes, I am confident that this is so, and therefore I am sure that I shall stay, and stay near you all, to promote your progress and joy in the Faith;

title: Philippians 1:26
text: So that, when you once more have me among you, you, in your union with Christ Jesus, may find in me fresh cause for exultation.

title: Philippians 1:27
text: Under all circumstances let your lives be worthy of the Good News of the Christ: so that, whether I come and see you, or whether I hear of your affairs at a distance, I may know that you are standing firm, animated by one spirit, and joining with one heart in a common struggle for the Faith taught by the Good News,

title: Philippians 1:28
text: Without ever shrinking from your opponents. To them this will be a sign of their Destruction and of your Salvation--a sign from God.

title: Philippians 1:29
text: For, on behalf of Christ, you have had the privilege granted you, not only of trusting in him, but also of suffering on his behalf.

title: Philippians 1:30
text: You will be engaged in the same hard struggle as that which you once saw me waging, and which you hear that I am waging still.

title: Philippians 2:1
text: If, then, any encouragement comes through union with Christ, if there is any persuasive power in love, if there is any communion with the Spirit, if there is any tenderness or pity,

title: Philippians 2:2
text: I entreat you to make my happiness complete--Live together animated by the same spirit and in mutual love, one in heart, animated by one Spirit.

title: Philippians 2:3
text: Nothing should be done in a factious spirit or from vanity, but each of you should with all humility regard others as of more account than himself,

title: Philippians 2:4
text: And one and all should consider, not only their own interests, but also the interests of others.

title: Philippians 2:5
text: Let the spirit of Christ Jesus be yours also.

title: Philippians 2:6
text: Though the divine nature was his from the beginning, yet he did not look upon equality with God as above all things to be clung to,

title: Philippians 2:7
text: But impoverished himself by taking the nature of a servant and becoming like men;

title: Philippians 2:8
text: He appeared among us as a man, and still further humbled himself by submitting even to death--to death on a cross!

title: Philippians 2:9
text: And that is why God raised him to the very highest place, and gave him the Name which stands above all other names,

title: Philippians 2:10
text: So that in adoration of the Name of Jesus every knee should bend, in Heaven, on earth, and under the earth,

title: Philippians 2:11
text: And that every tongue should acknowledge JESUS CHRIST as LORD- -to the glory of God the Father.

title: Philippians 2:12
text: Therefore, my dear friends, as you have always been obedient in the past, so now work out your own Salvation with anxious care, not only when I am with you, but all the more now that I am absent.

title: Philippians 2:13
text: Remember it is God who, in his kindness, is at work within you, enabling you both to will and to work.

title: Philippians 2:14
text: In all that you do, avoid murmuring and dissension,

title: Philippians 2:15
text: So as to prove yourselves blameless and innocent-- 'faultless children of God, in the midst of an evil-disposed and perverse generation,' in which you are seen shining like stars in a dark world,

title: Philippians 2:16
text: Offering to men the Message of Life; and then I shall be able at the Day of Christ to boast that I did not run my course for nothing, or toil for nothing.

title: Philippians 2:17
text: And yet, even if, when your faith is offered as a sacrifice to God, my life-blood must be poured out in addition, still I shall rejoice and share the joy of you all;

title: Philippians 2:18
text: And do you also rejoice and share my joy.

title: Philippians 2:19
text: I hope, however, as one who trusts in the Lord Jesus, to send Timothy to you before long, so that I may myself be cheered by receiving news of you.

title: Philippians 2:20
text: For I have no one but him to send--no one of kindred spirit who would take the same genuine interest in your welfare.

title: Philippians 2:21
text: They are all pursuing their own aims and not those of Christ Jesus.

title: Philippians 2:22
text: But you know what Timothy has proved himself to be, and how, like a child working for his father, he worked hard with me in spreading the Good News.

title: Philippians 2:23
text: It is Timothy, then, whom I hope to send, as soon as ever I can foresee how it will go with me.

title: Philippians 2:24
text: And I am confident, as one who trusts in the Lord Jesus, that before long I myself shall follow.

title: Philippians 2:25
text: Still I think it necessary to send Epaphroditus to you now, for he is my brother, fellow-worker, and fellow-soldier, and he was also your messenger to help me in my need.

title: Philippians 2:26
text: For he has been longing to see you all, and has been distressed because you heard of his illness.

title: Philippians 2:27
text: And I can assure you that his illness very nearly proved fatal. But God had pity on him, and not on him only but also on me, that I might not have sorrow upon sorrow.

title: Philippians 2:28
text: I am all the more ready, therefore, to send him, so that the sight of him may revive your spirits and my own sorrow be lightened.

title: Philippians 2:29
text: Give him, then, the heartiest of Christian welcomes, and hold such men in great honour.

title: Philippians 2:30
text: For it was owing to his devotion to the Master's work that he was at the point of death, having risked his own life in the effort to supply what was wanting in the help that you sent me.

title: Philippians 3:1
text: In conclusion, my Brothers, all joy be yours in your union with the Lord. To repeat what I have already written does not weary me, and is the safe course for you.

title: Philippians 3:2
text: Beware of those 'dogs'! Beware of those mischievous workers! Beware of the men who mutilate themselves!

title: Philippians 3:3
text: For it is we who are the circumcised--we whose worship is prompted by the Spirit of God, who exult in Christ Jesus, and who do not rely upon external privileges;

title: Philippians 3:4
text: Though I, if any man, have cause to rely even upon them. If any one thinks he can rely upon external privileges, far more can I!

title: Philippians 3:5
text: I was circumcised when eight days old; I am an Israelite by race, and of the tribe of Benjamin; I am a Hebrew, and the child of Hebrews. As to the Law, I was a Pharisee;

title: Philippians 3:6
text: As to zeal, I was a persecutor of the Church; as to such righteousness as is due to Law, I proved myself blameless.

title: Philippians 3:7
text: But all the things which I once held to be gains I have now, for the Christ's sake, come to count as loss.

title: Philippians 3:8
text: More than that, I count everything as loss, for the sake of the exceeding value of the knowledge of Christ Jesus my Lord. And for his sake I have lost everything, and count it as refuse, if I may but gain Christ and be found in union with him;

title: Philippians 3:9
text: Any righteousness that I have being, not the righteousness that results from Law, but the righteousness which comes through faith in Christ--the righteousness which is derived from God and is founded on faith.

title: Philippians 3:10
text: Then indeed I shall know Christ, and the power of his resurrection, and all that it means to share his sufferings,

title: Philippians 3:11
text: In the hope that, if I become like him in death, I may possibly attain to the resurrection from the dead.

title: Philippians 3:12
text: Not that I have already laid hold of it, or that I am already made perfect. But I press on, in the hope of actually laying hold of that for which indeed I was laid hold of by Christ Jesus.

title: Philippians 3:13
text: For I, Brothers, do not regard myself as having yet laid hold of it. But this one thing I do--forgetting what lies behind, and straining every nerve for that which lies in front,

title: Philippians 3:14
text: I press on to the goal, to gain the prize of that heavenward Call which God gave me through Christ Jesus.

title: Philippians 3:15
text: Let all of us, then, whose faith is mature, think thus. Then, if on any matter you think otherwise, God will make that also plain to you.

title: Philippians 3:16
text: Only we are bound to order our lives by what we have already attained.

title: Philippians 3:17
text: Brothers, unite in following my example, and fix your eyes on those who are living by the pattern which we have set you.

title: Philippians 3:18
text: For there are many--of whom I have often told you, and now tell you even with tears--who are living in enmity to the cross of the Christ.

title: Philippians 3:19
text: The end of such men is Ruin; for their appetites are their God, and they glory in their shame; their minds are given up to earthly things.

title: Philippians 3:20
text: But the State of which we are citizens is in Heaven; and it is from Heaven that we are eagerly looking for a Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ,

title: Philippians 3:21
text: Who, by the exercise of his power to bring everything into subjection to himself, will make this body that we have in our humiliation like to that body which he has in his Glory.

title: Philippians 4:1
text: So then, my dear Brothers, whom I am longing to see--you who are my joy and my crown, stand fast in union with the Lord, dear friends.

title: Philippians 4:2
text: I entreat Euodia, and I entreat Syntyche, to live in harmony, in union with the Lord;

title: Philippians 4:3
text: Yes, and I ask you, my true comrade, to help them, remembering that they toiled by my side in spreading the Good News; and so, too, did Clement and my other fellow-workers, whose names are 'in the Book of Life.'

title: Philippians 4:4
text: All joy be yours at all times in your union with the Lord. Again I repeat--All joy be yours.

title: Philippians 4:5
text: Let your forbearing spirit be plain to every one. The Lord is near.

title: Philippians 4:6
text: Do not be anxious about anything; but under all circumstances, by prayer and entreaty joined with thanksgiving, make your needs known to God.

title: Philippians 4:7
text: Then the Peace of God, which is beyond all human understanding, will stand guard over your hearts and thoughts, through your union with Christ Jesus.

title: Philippians 4:8
text: In conclusion, Brothers, wherever you find anything true or honorable, righteous or pure, lovable or praiseworthy, or if 'virtue' and 'honour' have any meaning, there let your thoughts dwell.

title: Philippians 4:9
text: All that you learned and received and heard and saw in me put into practice continually; and then God, the giver of peace, will be with you.

title: Philippians 4:10
text: It was a matter of great joy to me, as one in union with the Lord, that at length your interest in me had revived. The interest indeed you had, but not the opportunity.

title: Philippians 4:11
text: Do not think that I am saying this under the pressure of want. For I, however I am placed, have learned to be independent of circumstances.

title: Philippians 4:12
text: I know how to face humble circumstances, and I know how to face prosperity. Into all and every human experience I have been initiated--into plenty and hunger, into prosperity and want.

title: Philippians 4:13
text: I can do everything in the strength of him who makes me strong!

title: Philippians 4:14
text: Yet you have acted nobly in sharing my troubles.

title: Philippians 4:15
text: And you at Philippi know, as well as I, that in the early days of the Good News--at the time when I had just left Macedonia--no Church, with the one exception of yourselves, had anything to do with me as far as giving and receiving are concerned.

title: Philippians 4:16
text: Indeed, even while I was still in Thessalonica, you sent more than once to relieve my wants.

title: Philippians 4:17
text: It is not that I am anxious for your gifts, but I am anxious to see the abundant return that will be placed to your account. I have enough of everything, and to spare.

title: Philippians 4:18
text: My wants are fully satisfied, now that I have received from Epaphroditus the gifts which you sent me--the sweet fragrance of a sacrifice acceptable and pleasing to God.

title: Philippians 4:19
text: And my God, out of the greatness of his wealth, will, in glory, fully satisfy your every need, through your union with Christ Jesus.

title: Philippians 4:20
text: To him, our God and Father, be ascribed all glory for every and ever. Amen.

title: Philippians 4:21
text: Give my greeting to every one of the People of Christ Jesus. The Brothers who are with me send your their greetings.

title: Philippians 4:22
text: All Christ's People here, and especially those who belong to the Emperor's household, send theirs.

title: Philippians 4:23
text: May the blessing of the Lord Jesus Christ rest on your souls.

title: Colossians 1:1
text: From Paul, an Apostle of Christ Jesus, by the will of God, and from Timothy, our Brother.

title: Colossians 1:2
text: To Christ's People at Colossae--the Brothers who are faithful to him: May God, our Father, bless you and give you peace.

title: Colossians 1:3
text: Whenever we pray, we never fail to thank God, the Father of our Lord, Jesus Christ, about you,

title: Colossians 1:4
text: Now that we have heard of your faith in Christ Jesus and of the love that you have for all his People,

title: Colossians 1:5
text: On account of the hope which awaits its fulfilment in Heaven. Of this hope you heard long ago in the true Message of the Good News which reached you--

title: Colossians 1:6
text: Bearing fruit and growing, as it does, through all the world, just as it did among you, from the very day that you heard of God's loving-kindness, and understood what that loving-kindness really is.

title: Colossians 1:7
text: It is just what you learned from Epaphras, our dear fellow- servant, who, as a minister of the Christ, faithfully represents us,

title: Colossians 1:8
text: And who told us of the love with which the Spirit has inspired you.

title: Colossians 1:9
text: And therefore we, from the very day that we heard this, have never ceased praying for you, or asking that you may possess that deeper knowledge of the will of God, which comes through all true spiritual wisdom and insight.

title: Colossians 1:10
text: Then you will live lives worthy of the Master, and so please God in every way. Your lives will be fruitful in every kind of good action, and your characters will grow through a fuller knowledge of God;

title: Colossians 1:11
text: You will be made strong at all points with a strength worthy of the power manifested in his Glory--strong to endure with patience, and even with gladness, whatever may befall you;

title: Colossians 1:12
text: And you will give thanks to the Father who made you fit to share the lot which awaits Christ's People in the realms of Light.

title: Colossians 1:13
text: For God has rescued us from the tyranny of Darkness, and has removed us into the Kingdom of his Son, who is the embodiment of his love,

title: Colossians 1:14
text: And through whom we have found deliverance in the forgiveness of our sins.

title: Colossians 1:15
text: For Christ is the very incarnation of the invisible God-- First-born and Head of all creation;

title: Colossians 1:16
text: For in him was created all that is in Heaven and on earth, the visible and the invisible--Angels and Archangels and all the Powers of Heaven.

title: Colossians 1:17
text: All has been created through him and for him. He was before all things, and all things unite in him;

title: Colossians 1:18
text: And he is the Head of the Church, which is his Body. The First-born from the dead, he is to the Church the Source of its Life, that he, in all things, may stand first.

title: Colossians 1:19
text: For it pleased the Father that in him the divine nature in all its fulness should dwell,

title: Colossians 1:20
text: And through him to reconcile all things to himself (making peace by the shedding of Christ's blood offered upon the cross)-- whether on earth or in Heaven.

title: Colossians 1:21
text: And it pleased God that you, once estranged from him and hostile towards him in your thoughts, intent only on wickedness--

title: Colossians 1:22
text: But now he has reconciled you to himself by the sacrifice of Christ's earthly body in death--it has pleased God that you should stand in his presence holy, pure, and blameless,

title: Colossians 1:23
text: If only you remain true to your Faith, firm and immovable, never abandoning the hope held out in the Good News to which you listened, which has been proclaimed among all created things under Heaven, and of which I, Paul, was made a minister.

title: Colossians 1:24
text: Now at last I can rejoice in my sufferings on your behalf, and in my own person I supplement the afflictions endured by the Christ, for the sake of his Body, the Church;

title: Colossians 1:25
text: Of which I myself became a minister in virtue of the office with which God entrusted me for your benefit, to declare the Message of God in all its fulness--

title: Colossians 1:26
text: That Truth which has been hidden from former ages and generations. But now it has been revealed to God's People,

title: Colossians 1:27
text: To whom it was his pleasure to make known the surpassing glory of that hidden Truth when proclaimed among the Gentiles--'Christ among you! Your Hope of glory!'

title: Colossians 1:28
text: This is the Christ whom we proclaim, warning every one, and instructing every one, with all the wisdom that we possess, in the hope of bringing every one into God's presence perfected by union with Christ.

title: Colossians 1:29
text: It is for that I toil, struggling with all the energy which he inspires and which works powerfully within me.

title: Colossians 2:1
text: I want you to know in how great a struggle I am engaged for you and for Christ's People at Laodicea, and for all who have not yet seen me;

title: Colossians 2:2
text: In the hope that they, being bound to one another by love, and keeping in view the full blessedness of a firm conviction, may be encouraged to strive for a perfect knowledge of God's hidden Truth,

title: Colossians 2:3
text: Even Christ himself, in whom all treasures of wisdom and knowledge lie hidden.

title: Colossians 2:4
text: I say this to prevent any one from deceiving you by plausible arguments.

title: Colossians 2:5
text: It is true that I am not with you in person, but I am with you in spirit, and am glad to see the good order and the unbroken front resulting from your faith in Christ.

title: Colossians 2:6
text: Since, therefore, you have received Jesus, the Christ, as your Lord, live your lives in union with him--

title: Colossians 2:7
text: Rooted in him, building up your characters through union with him, growing stronger through your faith, as you were taught, overflowing with faith and thanksgiving.

title: Colossians 2:8
text: Take care there is not some one who will carry you away by his 'philosophy'--a hollow sham!--following, as it does, mere human traditions, and dealing with puerile questions of this world, and not with Christ.

title: Colossians 2:9
text: For in Christ the Godhead in all its fulness dwells incarnate;

title: Colossians 2:10
text: And, by your union with him, you also are filled with it. He is the Head of all Archangels and Powers of Heaven.

title: Colossians 2:11
text: By your union with him you received a circumcision that was not performed by human hands, when you threw off the tyranny of the earthly body, and received the circumcision of the Christ.

title: Colossians 2:12
text: For in baptism you were buried with Christ; and in baptism you were also raised to Life with him, through your faith in the omnipotence of God, who raised him from the dead.

title: Colossians 2:13
text: And to you, who once were 'dead,' by reason of your sins and your uncircumcised nature--to you God gave Life in giving life to Christ! He pardoned all our sins!

title: Colossians 2:14
text: He canceled the bond which stood against us--the bond that consisted of ordinances--and which was directly hostile to us! He has taken it out of our way by nailing it to the cross!

title: Colossians 2:15
